segments.text: Silver surged 147% outpacing dollar assets in 202025.
segments.narration: Silver surged 147 percent outpacing dollar assets in 202025.

Buy physical silver, store it yourself, and dollar-cost average into it every month. Silver protects your purchasing power because its supply cannot be printed, and in 2025 it surged roughly 147 percent, far outpacing dollar-denominated assets as currency-debasement concerns mounted . The dollars in your checking account lost value last year.

More dollars chasing the same goods means each dollar buys less. That is currency devaluation in one sentence. CPI inflation kept eating purchasing power through 2025, on top of a cumulative loss of about 20 percent since 2020 . A $100 bill from 2020 buys roughly $80 of groceries today.

At a 70/30 split, roughly $1,400 goes into silver. At current spot levels that buys a meaningful starter stack of one-ounce coins. Stick to recognized government-minted coins for your first $5,000 in silver. They carry slightly higher premiums than generic rounds, but they resell instantly anywhere in the country at full liquid value.

Telemarketers push these because the markups can exceed 50 percent. You are buying metal to hedge currency, not collecting rare dates. Stick to bullion priced near spot plus a small premium. The global silver market is on course for its fifth consecutive structural supply deficit, with the cumulative 2021 to 2025 shortfall approaching 820 million ounces .

After 12 months you will know your blended cost basis, your average premium, and your total ounces. That is the data you need to make smart decisions in year two, like whether to shift toward larger bars to lower your premium per ounce.

Budget $400 to $800 for something that will actually slow a thief down. Add a few silica gel packs and replace them annually. For stacks between 200 and 1,000 ounces, split your holdings. Keep roughly a third at home for immediate access and put the rest in a safe deposit box at a local credit union.

The whole point is access outside the banking system. Silver industrial demand reached a record high in 2024 and remained the largest single demand category through 2025 . Solar panels, electric vehicles, electronics, and medical applications consume hundreds of millions of ounces every year and most of that silver is gone forever.

Treasury Inflation-Protected Securities pay you CPI plus a small real yield. The problem is CPI understates the real cost of living for most households, and TIPS are still dollar-denominated. You are trusting the issuer of the currency to fairly measure how much they are debasing it.

Next week, place your first order for one-ounce Silver Eagles or Maple Leafs and have them shipped insured. The week after, install your safe and log the delivery. By month twelve you will hold roughly 80 to 100 ounces of recognized bullion and a real position outside the banking system. The dollar will keep losing value on its own schedule.
